## History

God is a central religious figure whose formal prayers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never been taught. During her first night at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) improvises a prayer to God at Marilla's insistence, addressing Him in an unconventional manner that leaves [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shocked by her spiritual ignorance. God is subsequently the focus of Sunday school, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends a dry lesson about Him and listens to a minister deliver a long sermon about His work.
